QuestInfo.name: [Springtime] Grillin' With My Homies
QuestInfo.0: Someone needs your help! Won't you answer?
QuestInfo.1: The Moon Bunny got a whiff of your delectable Fire Grill Skewer and broke free! Maybe you should reward it with a nibble.
QuestInfo.2: The Moon Bunny loved that skewer. Come back any time you have one.
